description: Renovate finds new versions of the open-source components this cluster runs and opens a pull request with the upstream change notes. It never merges: an Agent reads the notes, runs scripts/k3s/pluto-report.sh, takes the change through STG and then PROD.

First round is deliberately narrow: only a version that carries a `# renovate:` line above it is proposed (scripts/k3s/versions.env, the Helm chart pins in the install scripts, Gitea and kube-vip). The CloudNativePG operator is left out on purpose: its version appears twice in one URL and it runs the only database. Widen once the round trip has been walked.

customManagers.description: scripts/k3s/versions.env: a `# renovate:` line, then NAME=version
Helm chart pins in the install scripts: a `# renovate:` line, then NAME="${NAME:-version}"
Image tags in the few manifests that carry a `# renovate:` line above `image:`

packageRules.description: One pull request per component; majors are proposed but never grouped with anything
Gitea: stay inside the running minor until the merge lane's reliance on 1.21 behaviour has been checked against a newer one
